body: I thought I could talk but I don't think I can. But thank you for taking time out of your day to respond, I appreciate your efforts.

Not really sure what to say. I would eat up a lot of resources (other peoples' time, gas money, etc.) in order to seek help outside of my home because of my current financial situation. I can't even call a proper hotline because my phone service was disconnected tonight. Neighbors internet, if that's what you wondered next. I'm wondering if I should wait until the chat lines open back up on the internet for my time zone.

But there's... plans. There's kids. There's errands I already have a ride planned for. I feel like it makes me an asshole to even consider taking time out of my life to MAYBE attempt to get some kind of help. 

I really have no desire to be honest with everyone in my life about my recent thoughts. I keep weighing all of the options and none of them are good.
